IPI has no FARA registration despite receiving Norwegian government funding and hosting US Congressional members on advisory boards. Norway has 50 FARA-registered foreign principals, but IPI -- which received $650K in Epstein-conduit funds and lobbied Congress on foreign policy -- appears nowhere in the FARA database. This is a potential FARA violation.

International Peace Institute (IPI) has ZERO lobbying filings in Senate LDA records despite maintaining 33+ Congressional members on its advisory board and operating what amounted to a Congressional influence pipeline. IPI facilitated CODELs (Congressional delegations), hosted Congressional events, and maintained relationships with sitting members of Congress. The absence of lobbying registration, combined with documented Congressional influence activities, raises questions about compliance with the Lobbying Disclosure Act (LDA). Under 2 USC 1602, organizations that spend above threshold amounts on lobbying contacts with covered officials must register.

IPI (EIN 03-0213226) 990 filings show dramatic financial decline correlating with Epstein exposure. Peak assets were .6M in 2010, declining steadily to .4M in 2014, .7M in 2015, .7M in 2016, .7M in 2017, .5M in 2018, .4M in 2019, then collapsing to .9M in 2020 (COVID+Epstein), recovering briefly to .3M in 2021, but continuing decline to .4M in 2022 and .9M in 2023. Revenue dropped from .9M (2014) to .9M (2020) - a 67% collapse. The 2020 year shows revenue of only .9M against .6M in expenses, indicating severe financial distress.

IPI expenses have consistently exceeded revenue since 2015, indicating the organization has been drawing down reserves. Revenue vs expenses gap: 2015 (.3M vs .2M), 2016 (.5M vs .5M), 2017 (.7M vs .6M), 2018 (.4M vs .6M), 2019 (.3M vs .1M), 2020 (.9M vs .6M), 2023 (.0M vs .6M). The persistent deficit since 2015 suggests IPI lost a major funding source and has been spending down endowment. This aligns with the KPMG-confirmed K Epstein conduit and subsequent donor flight.

IPI cumulative financial analysis from 990 filings: Over 2010-2023, IPI ran a cumulative deficit of .5M. Assets declined from .6M (2010) to .9M (2023), a 73% decline. Only TWO years showed surpluses: 2010 (+.4M) and 2021 (+.9M). Five years showed deficits exceeding M: 2011 (-.1M, worst single year), 2016 (-.0M), 2018 (-.3M), 2020 (-.7M, COVID+Epstein), 2023 (-.6M). The 2011 deficit of .1M on .6M revenue suggests a major one-time write-down or accounting adjustment. At current burn rate (.6M/yr deficit), IPI has approximately 2.5 years of reserves remaining.

IPI 2011 anomaly: Revenue was only .64M against .71M in expenses, creating an .07M deficit in a single year. This was by far the worst year. The prior year (2010) showed .63M in revenue and .6M in assets. The 2011 collapse took assets from .6M to .5M. This could represent: (1) a major investment loss, (2) a one-time accounting adjustment, (3) loss of a very large donor. The 2010 revenue of .6M vs 2011 revenue of .6M represents an 81% year-over-year decline that preceded the Epstein plea deal. This warrants examination of the actual 2011 990 PDF to understand the revenue collapse.

IPI FARA LEGAL ANALYSIS: IPI has zero FARA registrations despite receiving funding from Norwegian government (confirmed as 'donor country' in EFTA02675352: 'which we usually forward to donor countries like Sweden or Norway'). IPI's activities that potentially trigger FARA: (1) Received $650K KPMG-confirmed Epstein conduit funds while Norwegian national Rod-Larsen was president; (2) Hosted Ministerial Working Dinners at 777 UN Plaza with UAE, Luxembourg, and other foreign government officials; (3) Operated Mongolia Advisory Board paying $100K each to former heads of state (Rod-Larsen, Summers, Barak, Bondevik, Rudd); (4) Rod-Larsen forwarded IPI program activities 'which we usually forward to donor countries' directly to Epstein; (5) IPI bank instructions sent to Epstein for $5M Gates Foundation wire (EFTA02707935). COUNTER-ARGUMENTS: (a) IPI's Congressional engagement (hosting 33+ members) goes beyond academic research; (b) Norwegian government was a confirmed donor country; (c) Rod-Larsen directed IPI activities through Epstein, a non-diplomatic channel; (d) $5.86M total Epstein-directed funding makes IPI financially dependent on non-transparent sources. COMPARABLE: Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation registered 6 FARA entries (via Waxman Consulting #6710, Center for International Policy #6896), showing Norway DOES register its grantees. IPI's absence is anomalous.
